heroSummary: CVESD's year-round calendar starts July 23 and includes 180 school days, 51 minimum days, and five teacher prep days. Its two-week Fall Break arrives in late September, followed by a Winter Break that extends through January 12.
seoDescription: CVESD Calendar 2025-2026 with first day, last day, Fall Break, Thanksgiving Week Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, minimum days, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: Chula Vista Elementary School District starts the 2025-2026 school year-round calendar on July 23, 2025 and ends on June 5, 2026. The official calendar lists 180 school days, 51 minimum days, 5 teacher prep days, Fall Break from September 22-October 3, Thanksgiving Week Break from November 24-28, Winter Break from December 22-January 12, and Spring Break from March 23-April 3.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CVESD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for CVESD students is Wednesday, July 23, 2025. The day is listed as a minimum day on the official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CVESD Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, September 22 through Friday, October 3, 2025, with students returning on Tuesday, October 7, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CVESD Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Monday, January 12, 2026. Students return on Tuesday, January 13, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CVESD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 23 through Friday, April 3, 2026. Students return on Monday, April 6, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CVESD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for CVESD students is Friday, June 5, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days are in the CVESD 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official CVESD 2025-2026 School Year-Round Calendar lists 180 school days.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the CVESD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the CVESD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: CVESD Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content: The CVESD 2025-2026 School Year-Round Calendar provides districtwide elementary student dates for school-year planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, last day of school, Fall Break, Thanksgiving Week Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, minimum days, parent/teacher conferences, teacher prep days, legal holidays, and declared holidays.

customSections.label: Important CVESD Dates Parents Should Know
customSections.content: These CVESD dates are common planning anchors for childcare, transportation, conferences, family travel, and school transitions.

customSections.label: How We Verify CVESD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official CVESD school calendars page and published School Year-Round Calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last day, Fall Break, Thanksgiving Week Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, minimum days, parent/teacher conference windows, teacher prep days, legal holidays, and declared holidays, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official CVESD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, school-site schedules, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
